message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: illegal burning of straw causing forest fire, resulting in forest area burned 2.0071 hectares. This likely constitutes "非法开采、毁坏森林资源罪" or "放火罪" (arson). Under Chinese law, causing forest fire by burning straw is "非法占用、毁坏森林资源罪" (Article 338 of Criminal Law) or "放火罪" (Article 114). Actually, Article 338: "非法占用、毁坏森林资源罪" includes causing forest fire by burning. Also Article 114: "放火罪" includes setting fire to forest, causing fire. The act is "私自焚烧秸秆不慎引发山火". It's not intentional arson, but negligent. Could be "过失放火罪" (negligent arson) under Article 115? Actually Article 115 is "过失放火罪". So the crime is "过失放火罪". The prosecution suggests 1-2 years, which matches the penalty for "过失放火罪" (3 years or less). So answer: [罪名]过失放火罪<eoa>
